lines.beaver: 회원님, 석 달 운동해 보니 어떠세요?
lines.beaver_en: How do you feel after three months of exercise?
lines.beaver_roman: hoewonnim, seok dal undonghae boni eotteoseyo?
lines.learner: 다리가 가벼워요. 근력 운동 효과가 큰 모양이에요.
lines.en: My legs feel light. Strength training seems really effective.
lines.roman: dariga gabyeowoyo. geullyeok undong hyogwaga keun moyangieyo.

lines.learner: 오래 뛰어도 숨이 덜 차요. 지구력도 좋은 모양이에요.
lines.en: I get less out of breath on long runs. My endurance seems good too.
lines.roman: orae ttwieodo sumi deol chayo. jiguryeokdo joeun moyangieyo.

lines.beaver_en: How is your reaction speed when catching the ball?
lines.learner: 공을 잘 잡아요. 순발력도 나아진 모양이에요.
lines.en: I catch the ball well. My reflexes seem to have improved too.
lines.roman: gongeul jal jabayo. sunballyeokdo naajin moyangieyo.

lines.learner: 저녁마다 반신욕을 해요. 몸이 덜 뻐근해요.
lines.en: I take a half-body bath every evening. My body feels less stiff.
lines.roman: jeonyeongmada bansinyogeul haeyo. momi deol ppeogeunhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Half-body baths do help with recovering from fatigue.
lines.learner: 피로가 금방 풀려요. 효과가 좋은 모양이에요.
lines.en: My fatigue goes away quickly. It seems to work well.
lines.roman: piroga geumbang pullyeoyo. hyogwaga joeun moyangieyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you rest on weekends?
lines.learner: 산에 가서 삼림욕을 해요. 마음이 편해요.
lines.en: I go to the mountains for forest bathing. It calms my mind.
lines.roman: sane gaseo samnimnyogeul haeyo. maeumi pyeonhaeyo.

lines.learner: 숲에 다녀오면 푹 자요. 공기 덕분인 모양이에요.
lines.en: After the forest, I sleep soundly. It must be thanks to the air.
lines.roman: supe danyeoomyeon puk jayo. gonggi deokbunin moyangieyo.

lines.beaver: 운동과 체력에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about exercise and fitness?
lines.beaver_roman: undonggwa cheryeoge daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 꾸준한 단련이 중요해요. 몸이 정직한 모양이에요.
lines.en: Steady training matters. The body seems to be honest.
lines.roman: kkujunhan dallyeoni jungyohaeyo. momi jeongjikan moyangieyo.

lines.beaver: 맞습니다. 다음 달에는 근력 운동을 늘려 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Right. Shall we add more strength training next month?
lines.beaver_roman: matseumnida. daeum dareneun geullyeok undongeul neullyeo bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 순발력 운동도 같이 하고 싶어요.
lines.en: Sounds good. I'd like to do agility training too.
lines.roman: joayo. sunballyeok undongdo gachi hago sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 다음 주부터 해 봅시다. 수고하셨습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's start next week. Good work today.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom daeum jubuteo hae bopsida. sugohasyeotseumnida.
lines.en: Thank you, coach. See you next week.
